name: cogentstack
description: Open CogentStack in a joined 50/50 signed-in browser companion beside ChatGPT or Codex, optionally use an isolated in-Codex panel, build approved projects, prepare approved deployment packs, and execute explicitly confirmed project-folder deletions.

interface.shortDescription: Open a joined browser companion, build, deploy, and manage projects.
interface.longDescription: CogentStack opens the hosted workspace with the registered Windows browser, using Chrome or Edge and its last-used normal profile, hides the desktop sidebar, and joins the visible window frames in an aligned 50/50 split. An existing CogentStack website login in that profile is retained without copying cookies or credentials. An isolated native Codex panel remains available only when explicitly requested and requires separate Desktop authorization. Natural-language briefs become explicitly approved projects through verified server-generated artifacts, approved Deployment Packs can be prepared, and project-folder deletion runs only after exact hosted confirmation. Project Type Contracts, blueprints, compatibility rules, licence validation, and subscriber data remain on the protected CogentStack service.
defaultPrompt: Open the CogentStack workspace beside this app.
Keep the CogentStack workspace inside Codex instead.
Build the approved project I describe in this composer.
Prepare the Deployment Pack I approved in CogentStack.
Delete the project I explicitly approved for deletion in CogentStack.
